verse.verse_1: May both the hands of Abu Lahab be destroyed – and they are destroyed!
verse.verse_2: His wealth did not benefit him in the least, nor did whatever he earned.
verse.verse_3: He will soon enter the flaming fire.
verse.verse_4: And so will his wife; carrying a bundle of firewood on her head.
verse.verse_5: A rope made from palm fibre around her neck!
